verdict.rationale: Superhuman's own docs confirm read statuses: it can check which emails have been read, including via MCP, and read statuses are shared across a team. Community reports corroborate open tracking, including how many times an email was opened, and say read receipts became non-default after the controversy. No first-party doc describes per-recipient open timestamps (the 'when' part), and the feature now requires opting in. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of when each recipient opened, per-recipient detail, and setup/enablement docs for read statuses.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can see whether and when recipients opened my email

citations.quote: Superhuman Mail can check which emails have been read
Read statuses are now shared across your team, so anybody can follow up with full context.
Superhuman's tracking tells senders how many times, and from where, a recipient opened an email
